VenueHost-latest.zip was intentionally not generated in the ChatGPT sandbox because .NET/Dalamud build tooling is not available here.

Run from PowerShell in the repo root:

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Build-DalamudPackage.ps1

The script will build and recreate dist/VenueHost-latest.zip after validating versions and required package files.
